data.name: ContributionModeHelper
data.value: How the values of several Synchronization Rules are combined. Priority takes them from the highest-priority contributor; Accumulate adds every value and never removes one through synchronization; Merge adds every value and removes one once no contributor supplies it.

data.name: AccumulateNotice
data.value: From each Metaverse Object's next synchronization, every contributor adds its values to this attribute, and synchronization never removes one, even after the account that supplied it is deleted.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateNotice
data.value: At each Metaverse Object's next synchronization, the values this attribute kept that no contributor supplies any more are removed, and exports remove them from target systems.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateWarning
data.value: Changing '{0}' to {1} removes, at each Metaverse Object's next synchronization, the values that no contributor supplies any more, and exports then remove them from target systems. They cannot be recovered.

data.name: PriorityListAccumulateNotice
data.value: This attribute uses the Accumulate contribution mode: every Synchronization Rule below adds its values and none is preferred, so there is no order to set, and "Null is a value" has no effect.

data.name: MergeNotice
data.value: From each Metaverse Object's next synchronization, every contributor adds its values to this attribute, and a value is removed only once no contributor supplies it.

data.name: PriorityListMergeNotice
data.value: This attribute uses the Merge contribution mode: every Synchronization Rule below adds its values and none is preferred, so there is no order to set, and "Null is a value" has no effect.
